title: I need help, I created a follower system that allows the player to talk to the follower, but that slows down their movement

posts.author: Yabuki
posts.body:
Hi, I'm new using RPG Maker
and for a game I made this little event where you can choose a character to join your party, it follows the player and the player can interact with them...
But since I first created the part of just following the player, I realized that when I added the condition to interact with the npc it starts to go very slow.
This is what I did:
I would like to know what I can do to stop this from happening or if there is a better way to implement this mechanic, I think it's because I'm using a parallel process as a trigger, but otherwise it doesn't work, I tried to make it autorun but the game freezes.
I need some advice on this because I think it could lead to other problems...
Any help is appreciated

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Welcome to the forums!
I would recommend using Autonomous movement, and set that to follow. Make sure you change the Speed and Freq to normal. Do this for Both pages
This way he'll follow you automatically.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the parallel process for checkinmg the talk button needs a wait(5) or wait(10).
currently it is checking the button sixty times a second - you can't press the button that fast, so that is a lot of unneccessary checks creating the lag.
the waits will reduce that to a much slower check, which will be enough without causing lag.

posts.author: Yabuki
posts.body: Thank you so much! Both tips helped me and it works much better now : D
